purpose: Single review-before-decision dossier for the NFL line-origination project: the questions that must be answered before any decision, what is already known (with sources), what is missing, what blocks any reward, and the suggestions that would discover each missing item.

irregularity_NF16.summary: Two parallel suggestion registers with different ID schemes coexist (S01-S10 in decisions.json and SU-01..SU-12 in nfl-suggestions.json); a third question register (DQ01-DQ17) overlaps both.
irregularity_NF16.recommendation: Treat research/nfl/decisions.json as the canonical register; this dossier cross-maps SU-* and DQ-* to it. Do not maintain a second independent suggestion list.

questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.question: May this research be published at all, in this form?
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.known_text: NFL.com terms 1.3 allow individual non-commercial informational use and prohibit systematic retrieval to build a collection without written consent.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.missing_text: Whether a frozen, attributed, non-commercial research note is acceptable, and what consent would be needed for anything larger.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.resolves_if: Written permission is obtained, or the source is replaced with one whose terms permit redistribution.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.owner_needed: No, but a rights decision is required from whoever publishes it.

questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.question: Are the originated Week 10 numbers internally consistent and reproducible?
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.known_text: Yes in the narrow sense: one score pair per game drives both the spread and the total, and the build is byte-identical from hashed inputs.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.missing_text: Any external check. A coherent number can still be a wrong number.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.resolves_if: The originated numbers are compared with recorded market prices (S01).
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.blocks: Nothing on the site; blocks every accuracy claim

questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.question: Is a 2.0-point home adjustment defensible for all 14 games?
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.known_text: It is disclosed as a project assumption. No official NFL home-field value was retrieved.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.missing_text: A sourced home-field estimate, and separate handling for the Munich international fixture.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.resolves_if: A range is published per game (S08) and the neutral-site game is relabelled.

questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.question: Do we know which clubs are starting second- or third-string players?
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.known_text: Two Commanders players are listed Out with a stated reason, and one Giant is Questionable with a reason. Practice participation is published for all 20 listed players.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.missing_text: Whether any of them is a starter, who replaces them, and how much the replacement plays.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.resolves_if: A depth chart plus snap counts are stored (S02).

questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.question: What does a blank game status mean?
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.known_text: It is blank on the official page for 17 of the 20 listed players. The policy says a player certain to play is not listed on the game status report.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.missing_text: The page does not state, per row, that blank equals available.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.resolves_if: The league policy page is read in full and a dated rule is stored, or the field stays blank forever (S07).

questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.question: How much do two legs of the same game move together?
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.known_text: Nothing measured. Team-level correlations exist but are a different quantity and five of ten are arithmetic artefacts.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.missing_text: Joint hit rates on the actual leg pairs.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.resolves_if: Paired leg outcomes are collected and phi with an interval is computed per pair (S03).

questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.question: Can three or more legs be priced from pairwise numbers?
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.known_text: No. Pairwise dependence does not identify a joint distribution of three or more variables.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.missing_text: A joint model, or a simulation with an explicit and tested dependence structure.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.resolves_if: A copula or block-bootstrap simulation is specified, published and tested against outcomes.

questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.question: Is anything here skill-based rather than luck?
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.known_text: Points-based expectation scored Brier 0.1575 against 0.25 for a flat guess on 32 clubs, so the scoring profile carried information about the displayed record.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.missing_text: Out-of-sample evidence. The comparison is inside one snapshot and cannot separate skill from a correlated season.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.resolves_if: Walk-forward scoring across two prior seasons (S04) shows the same result after the model sees only earlier games.

questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.question: How much of each club's record is luck?
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.known_text: Every club is within about 2.2 wins of its points-based expectation; Denver and Tampa Bay are the largest gaps at about 2.17 wins.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.missing_text: Schedule strength, opponent adjustment, and any measure of how much of the gap persists.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.resolves_if: Opponent-adjusted ratings are computed from two seasons of dated results (S04).

questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.question: Is any strategy profitable?
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.known_text: No. Zero strategies are qualified, no price was retrieved, and ROI and CLV are blank by rule.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.missing_text: Every price, limit, hold and settlement rule.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.resolves_if: S01 and S05 are completed and a forward record exists.

questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.question: What would make a reward decision reasonable?
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.known_text: The blocked list is published: a dated price, depth and snap data, and a dependence estimate.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.missing_text: A forward, stake-capped record scored after settlement.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.resolves_if: The shadow ledger accumulates entries and the gate contract is met with artifact URLs.

questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.question: How much confidence does a single official page support?
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.known_text: Each value is parsed from saved page text and arithmetic is re-derived; the extractor refuses to publish contradictions.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.missing_text: A second independent source for any value used in a decision.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.resolves_if: A two-source rule is applied (S10) and single-source values stay labelled.

questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.question: What did we choose not to transcribe, and why?
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.known_text: Division and conference records, last-ten and several middle standings columns: the rendered table had no header row and its field order contradicts the page legend.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.missing_text: A reliable column identification for those fields.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.resolves_if: A source with an explicit header is retrieved, or the values are confirmed another way.

questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.question: Should the NBA material stay on the site?
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.known_text: It is a completed, separately scoped audit and its own source terms still apply.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.missing_text: A decision on whether the owner wants one sport or a multi-sport workspace.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.resolves_if: The owner states a preference; until then the NFL section is the landing page and the NBA pages remain reachable and labelled.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.owner_needed: Yes, this is the one genuine preference question.

questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.question: Can luck be removed from the equation at all?
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.known_text: It cannot be removed from a single result, and no method here claims to. What can be done is to state the chance a run of results is indistinguishable from randomness, and to report an interval rather than a point estimate. The repository already carries a permutation p-value, Holm adjustment, Brier scores and bootstrap intervals for the closed NBA study, so the method exists; the NFL sample does not.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.missing_text: Enough NFL outcomes to separate signal from noise, and a pre-registered test-deciding rule. One week of games cannot distinguish skill from luck for any strategy.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.resolves_if: Two prior seasons plus a pre-registered forward shadow, with the luck bound published before the results are seen (S04, S09).
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.blocks: Any skill claim and any reward

questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.question: Does the site's own check suite prove the published values are true?
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.known_text: No. scripts/check_site.py proves internal integrity: every row has a registered source link, links resolve, blanks are blank, builds are deterministic. It does not re-fetch a publisher and cannot detect a stale or mis-copied value.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.missing_text: An external re-check step, and a statement on each page of when its values were last read from the publisher.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.resolves_if: A dated re-verification log per value family becomes a build input, and a mismatch between the log date and the snapshot date is surfaced rather than hidden (this session's 2026-11-13 re-check is the first instance).
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.blocks: Nothing today; blocks any claim of continuous accuracy

questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.question: Which official source can name the player who replaced an injured starter?
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.known_text: Neither the injury report nor the league depth-chart path supplies it. The injury report lists 20 players for one game with statuses and no starter flag; nfl.com/teams/depth-chart serves no chart and a club depth-chart path returned a 404 on 2026-11-13.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.missing_text: A per-game participation source (snap counts) or a published lineup, plus a depth ordering for the club.
questions_to_answer_before_any_decision.resolves_if: A licensed or official participation source is identified and its terms allow the use, and a club-published depth order is captured with a date (S02).

information_held.statement: All 32 clubs have a 2026 record, points for, points against and a displayed win percentage as of the snapshot.
information_held.verification: Parsed from the saved page text; PCT re-derived from W/T/games, NET PTS re-derived from PF minus PA, HOME plus ROAD re-derived to the overall record.

information_held.statement: League scoring level in the snapshot.
information_held.verification: Sum of all PF divided by 272 team-games.

information_held.value: Buffalo 256 PF highest, LA Chargers 121 PF lowest; Jacksonville +108 net highest, LA Chargers -98 lowest
information_held.verification: Maximum and minimum of the parsed PF and NET PTS columns.

information_held.statement: Official injury reporting is mandatory and has fixed categories.
information_held.value: Practice: Did Not Participate / Limited (under 100% of normal reps) / Full (100%). Game status: Out, Doubtful, Questionable. 'Probable' was eliminated.
information_held.verification: Read the NFL news item reporting the Competition Committee revision.

information_held.statement: The Week 10 Thursday listing covers one game only in our snapshot.
information_held.value: 20 players, 9 Commanders and 11 Giants; 2 Out, 1 Questionable, 17 with a blank game status
information_held.verification: Counted from the parsed rows; blanks are copied from the page, not filled.

information_held.statement: Week 10 has 14 fixtures and 4 clubs on bye, covering the league exactly.
information_held.value: 14 fixtures, 28 clubs, plus CHI, DEN, PHI, TB on bye
information_held.verification: Fixture clubs plus byes equal the 32-club standings set; duplicate fixtures rejected.

information_held.statement: Points-based expectation carries real information about the displayed record in this snapshot.
information_held.value: Brier 0.1575 versus 0.25 for a flat .500 guess on 32 clubs
information_held.verification: Same 32 rows scored against the same actual outcomes; p=2.37 taken from the published convention, not fitted.

information_held.statement: Only five of the ten team-level correlations are independent evidence.
information_held.value: Five are structurally induced (net points shares its inputs with PF, PA and wins); no pair exceeds |r| without an arithmetic link.
information_held.verification: Each excluded pair is individually labelled on the correlation page.

information_held.statement: NFL.com terms restrict how this material may be used.
information_held.value: Section 1.3: individual non-commercial informational use only; systematic retrieval to compile a collection, database or directory is prohibited without written consent.
information_held.verification: Read the retrieved terms text, section 1.3.

information_held.statement: The two largest record-versus-scoring gaps are small in absolute terms.
information_held.value: Tampa Bay and Denver are each about 2.17 wins away from expectation; no club is more than 2.2 wins off.
information_held.verification: Actual W plus half of T, minus expected wins, for every club.

information_missing.question: What price, limit and hold does any operator actually offer on these Week 10 markets?
information_missing.why_it_matters: Without a timestamped quote there is no ROI, no closing-line value, no break-even test and no way to rank anything.
information_missing.blocks: Every ranked decision, every reward, all of G06

information_missing.question: Which listed player is a starter, and who replaces him?
information_missing.why_it_matters: The owner requirement names second-, third- and fourth-string exposure. A game status alone cannot tell you whether a starter is out.
information_missing.blocks: Availability-adjusted lines and every player-prop idea

information_missing.question: How many snaps, targets and carries does each player normally take?
information_missing.why_it_matters: Converts an absence into an expected change in team or player output. Without it, 'Out' is a label, not a number.
information_missing.blocks: The injury-to-line adjustment, all player props

information_missing.question: How do same-game legs actually depend on one another?
information_missing.why_it_matters: A parlay price assumes a joint distribution. Multiplying two probabilities assumes zero dependence, which is the assumption this project will not make.

information_missing.question: Is the current snapshot representative of full-season scoring, or is it an eight-game artefact?
information_missing.why_it_matters: Early-season scoring rates are noisy and schedule-dependent; a single partial season cannot support a forward claim.

information_missing.question: Under which operator's rule does each bet settle, especially pushes, overtime and voids?
information_missing.why_it_matters: Two operators can settle the same nominal bet differently, which changes the expected return before any edge is discussed.
information_missing.status: Partly documented for other sports; nothing for NFL

information_missing.question: May this material be published at all in its current form?
information_missing.why_it_matters: NFL.com terms limit use to individual non-commercial informational purposes and prohibit systematic retrieval without consent.
information_missing.blocks: Any dataset release, any commercial use, any redistribution

information_missing.question: What share of the observed record-versus-expectation gap is schedule strength rather than randomness?
information_missing.why_it_matters: The regression idea only becomes a signal once opponent quality is separated from luck.

information_missing.question: What does a blank game status on the official listing mean for that player?
information_missing.why_it_matters: 17 of the 20 listed players have a blank status. Treating blank as 'will play' would be an inference.
information_missing.blocks: Any use of the injury table as a playing-time forecast

information_missing.question: What is the true home-field advantage for these specific fixtures?
information_missing.why_it_matters: We used a single assumed constant of 2.0 points for all 14 games, including an international game in Munich.

suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.title: Record one dated operator quote per game, before kickoff
suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.acceptance_test: A capture file exists with book, market, line, price, limit and capture timestamp for at least one fixture, plus a second independent capture; both are cited by URL and date, and the rights note names the permission relied on.

suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.title: Build a sourced depth-chart and snap-share table
suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.acceptance_test: For at least one club and one position group, a published depth order of 1..n with a source URL and a check date, plus a usage table (snaps, targets or carries) with the same discipline. A row with no source is not created.

suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.title: Measure leg dependence before pricing any parlay
suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.acceptance_test: A paired-leg sample exists with both outcomes observed on the same games, and a measured dependence statistic with an interval and a sample size. No product-of-legs estimate is published in its place.

suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.title: Collect two full prior seasons of game results, then test out of sample
suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.acceptance_test: Two complete prior seasons of results exist as sourced rows; a walk-forward run is scored out of sample with a pre-registered rule; the run hash and the split dates are published before the score.

suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.title: Write one settlement specification per market before betting it
suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.acceptance_test: One written settlement specification per market naming push, void, overtime, stat-correction and DNP behaviour, each citing the operator's own published rules.

suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.title: Settle the rights question before collecting at scale
suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.acceptance_test: A written answer from the rights holder, or a documented decision to stay inside individual non-commercial use with no redistribution. An unanswered query is not an approval.

suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.title: Treat a blank status as unknown and prove it with a test
suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.status: Proposed · partially in place (blanks are already kept blank)
suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.acceptance_test: A test that fails when a blank status is read as availability, and a page cell that renders as blank rather than 'active'.

suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.title: Replace the single home-field constant with a tested range
suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.acceptance_test: A home-field estimate with a stated method, a range and a source, replacing the single 2.0 constant; the originated board is regenerated and the change is visible in the diff.

suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.title: Publish the shadow ledger now, empty, with its rules locked
suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.status: Published empty on the leaderboard page
suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.acceptance_test: A empty ledger with locked rules, a pre-registration timestamp and a hash, published before any entry can be added.

suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.title: Add a two-source rule for every future value
suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.status: Proposed · current values are single-source and labelled as such
suggestions_to_discover_missing_informat.acceptance_test: A second independent source registered for each value family, with a test that refuses a row carrying only one source.

review_workflow.rule: No proposal is implemented until a reviewer records Approved. The site is static and provides no approval control; the decision is recorded by editing this file and rebuilding, which leaves an auditable commit.
review_workflow.rejection_rule: A rejected suggestion keeps its row and gains a reason. Nothing is deleted, so the same idea is not silently re-proposed.

sources.note: Item statements, questions and source_ids are copied verbatim from the existing registers; no value was retyped or inferred.
